TC-01/S08.detail: One run (final2, 07:26:40-07:28:08Z; every cited file written by it): same account, normal browser A vs wrong-clock browsers signed in through the form on that browser: B (Pacific/Honolulu, server+1 d; device day = server day at this run's hour) and B2 (UTC, server+1 d). 'NEW TODAY' on H3 and HX (added today by the server's day) shows in A and is missing in B and B2. Day/visit numbers: absent in every context (judged in S26/S06). Badge (known TFA-92584 AC 8): B2 shows Follow-up for H1/N1 (New Admission) and H2/N3 (Consult), and after B2 opened the list the NORMAL browser also showed Follow-up - B2's applyLifecycle wrote the roll to the server with its own day. DOB rows (record-only, Q12): N6 'DOB Oct 14, 1939' and N7 'DOB Oct 15, 1939' show no age in any context. Test fixed: it waits for the post-sign-in redirect before navigating (an earlier final run failed on 'page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED at /rounding'), has a 5 min timeout (took 1.5 min), and clears earlier tc01-s08-* files first.
TC-01/S08.productIssue: On a computer whose clock or time zone is off (here Hawaii time a day ahead, or UTC a day ahead), a patient added today does not get the 'NEW TODAY' tag that every other device shows, because PatientCard compares addedAt with the device's own date. Breaks UAT 3.8 ('A phone with a wrong clock, no clock set, or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device') and TFA-92579 AC 3/4. Known and worse: such a device also rolls New Admission / Consult to Follow-up on the server for every device (TFA-92584 AC 8).
